description: At will, you can extend a cluster of grasping vines to grab one target and drag them in.  They have a range equal to 1/2 your Dexterity.
activation_msg: Vines lash out toward your target.

description: At will, you can transform your hands into jagged wooden claws.  They are potent weapons but make anything other than combat more difficult.
activation_msg: Your fingers itch as jagged wood rapidly covers them.
